_readme: The machine-checkable half of this project's contract. Enforced by .ironclad/gate.mjs. Loosening anything here requires an ADR stating why.
name: claude-code-foundry-gateway

boundaries.why: The Bicep template must deploy standalone, from the portal button or a pipeline, without any PowerShell in the path.

secretAllowlist.why: Placeholder tenant and client ids in documentation and generated policy examples are all-zero or example values, never real credentials.
Generated MDM policy examples carry example gateway URLs and zero-GUID tenant ids by construction.
